## Meeting Purpose

[Discuss and plan the development of an MVP for a canteen management system.](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=13.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [Defined core MVP features: worker management, canteen/company management, menu creation, meal selection, and basic reporting](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=18.0)
  - [Agreed to focus on functionality first, then improve UX and design later](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=135.0)
  - [Identified issues with theming and color schemes in the current implementation](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=260.0)
  - [Decided on task division: Adrian to work on menu management and backend, Luís on UI improvements and theming](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=407.0)

## Topics

### MVP Requirements

  - [Worker management: track workers' canteen assignments and company affiliations](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=24.0)
  - [Canteen and company management: CRUD operations for creating new canteens and companies](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=42.0)
  - [Menu management: create dishes, assign menus to calendar weeks](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=54.0)
  - [Meal selection: allow users to choose their meals](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=35.0)
  - [Basic reporting: summary of meal quantities for grocery planning (e.g., 50 of meal A, 100 of meal B)](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=59.0)

### Current Progress and Next Steps

  - [Menu management page needs database connection](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=192.0)
  - [Settings page is functional](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=208.0)
  - [Login page to be improved for immediate access](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=208.0)
  - [Backend connection to Supabase needed](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=260.0)
  - [Canteens, companies, and workers section requires refinement](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=278.0)
  - [Billing information needs improvement](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=286.0)

### UI/UX Improvements

  - [Consider creating a custom page creator instead of using dialogs](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=291.0)
  - [Aim to avoid dialogs on mobile unless information-heavy](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=365.0)
  - [Luís to focus on improving overall look and feel](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=447.0)
  - [Inspiration drawn from a Dribbble design for meal selection interface](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=458.0)

### Theming and Color Scheme Issues

  - [Current implementation uses hardcoded Tailwind color classes](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=899.0)
  - [Need to rework components to use ShadeCN theming instead of direct color tokens](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=899.0)
  - [Luís to attempt using V0 AI to recreate the UI with proper theming](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=1004.0)

      - [Enhance billing information display](https://fathom.video/share/DQXgdxeST5r-8gKs-hJWweCjexML6JXM?tab=summary&timestamp=286.0)
